title: Ledger entry
description: One file at docs/ledger/<kind>/<key[:2]>/<key>.json (decision 0079). It holds no timestamp, so equal results are byte-identical; provenance lives in a separate .prov.json file. Only pass and fail are stored: an error or an unavailable check is never a ledger result.

key_version.description: Version of the key scheme hashed into the key; a new scheme is a miss, never a stale hit.

inputs.description: Declared input name to content hash, so verify can recompute the key and explain can name the input that differs.

result.description: Kind-specific payload: a verdict, or the capped and redacted failing lines of a check. Never source or manuscript text.
